effect.name: Colour Key
effect.description: Makes one colour transparent. For sprite sheets exported without alpha, for punching a window out of a backdrop, and for cutting a hole in anything at runtime.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Key Colour
parameter.description: The colour to remove. Default is magenta.

parameter.name: Tolerance
parameter.description: How close a pixel has to be to the key colour to be removed.

parameter.name: Softness
parameter.description: Fades pixels out near the edge of the tolerance rather than cutting them hard.

parameter.name: Despill
parameter.description: Pulls the key colour back out of the pixels that survive, which kills the coloured fringe left around a cut-out.
